labels.label: bzdef:c1s1d3_sphere

hypotheses.paper: a topological vector space structure on E
hypotheses.note: the quotient topologies of S(E) and P(E) for any [TopologicalSpace E]; s open needs only [ContinuousConstSMul ℝ E]; antipodal map [ContinuousNeg E]

hypotheses.paper: by default, the finest locally convex topology on E
hypotheses.note: for E = ℝⁿ, the only space Ch. 1 equips with the default: the product topology is the finest locally convex, indeed the finest vector-space, topology (isLeast_pi_locallyConvexTopology, isLeast_pi_vectorSpaceTopology; any finite-dimensional E: le_of_t2_of_finiteDimensional), and S(n) carries its quotient topology (S.topology_eq). Certified so by DEC-114; not constructed for infinite-dimensional E (Mathlib has none), disclosed in SCOPE

ProjSpace E, a type synonym of Mathlib's Projectivization ℝ E with the topology coinduced from E − {O}; equal to the topology coinduced from S(E) through the antipodal quotient (coinduced_toProjSpace)

hypotheses.paper: S(E) ≃ unit sphere in finite dimension (DEC-113)
hypotheses.note: proved for every real normed space; compactness needs finite dimension

readings: DEC-114: Déf. 3 is certified with the lemma that the product topology on ℝⁿ is the finest locally convex one; an infinite-dimensional E keeps whatever topology it is given (the finest locally convex topology is not constructed).

kb_proposals: Benzecri.Sphere E is a `def` synonym of Module.Ray ℝ E (so no orphan topology lands on Module.Ray); work through Sphere.mk / Sphere.ind / Sphere.lift, and Sphere.ofCone C for 's(C - {O})' with F_ofCone / mk_mem_ofCone_iff for cones.
Sphere.homeomorphUnitSphere holds for every real normed space (no finite dimension); T2Space and (finite-dim) CompactSpace instances on Sphere E come from it.
Mathlib's global notation `GL` (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup) captures the identifier GL: the group names are GLR/GAR/GSR/GUR (WP-45d).

P(E) is Benzecri.ProjSpace E, a def synonym of Projectivization ℝ E carrying the quotient topology (no orphan instance on ℙ ℝ E); toProjSpace : Sphere E → ProjSpace E is a quotient map and the two quotient topologies agree by coinduced_compose.

Four Benzecri.Sphere names are protected (map_neg, neg_ne_self, continuous_neg, normalize): write Sphere.neg_ne_self etc. inside namespace Benzecri.Sphere; the homothety on E − {O} is Sphere.homothetyNZ.
notes: Fix round 1 (DEC-114, AUDIT-1): Déf. 3 MARKED and closed — the finite-dimensional default-topology lemma (audit's 3-line proof via LinearMap.continuous_on_pi) and P(E)'s quotient topology are built, the two quotient topologies of P(E) shown equal. Hygiene: the four root-shadowing names are protected, Sphere.homothety renamed homothetyNZ (Benzecri.homothety of Projective/Groups is the ℝˣ →* GL(E) one), the S(n−1) citation is l.278, neg_ne_self's docstring reworded. No sorry; axioms ⊆ {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}; clean under -DwarningAsError=true.
